# Barrits Project — LLM Context

This file provides essential context for LLM-assisted development on the Barrits monorepo.

## Quick Links
- README: ./README.md
- CHANGELOG: ./CHANGELOG.md
- Contributing: ./docs/development/EN/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Quick Start
- Requirements: Node.js >=18 (v22+), Deno >=2.x, Bun >=1.3 (optional)
- Setup: `git clone <repo> && npm install` (root workspace installs SDK deps automatically)
- Build: `cd packages/sdk/ts_js && npm run build`
- Test: `cd packages/sdk/ts_js && npm test` (964 tests total)
- Typecheck: `cd packages/sdk/ts_js && npx tsc --noEmit` (0 errors expected)
- Explore examples: `cd packages/sdk/ts_js/examples/` — 11 examples covering Node, Deno, Bun, React, Solid, Svelte, Vue, Tauri, and bundlers (Vite, esbuild, Rollup, Webpack)

## Architecture
- Monorepo with npm workspaces
- Primary SDK at packages/sdk/ts_js/
- Test runner: node:test (via tsx --test)
- Build: tsup + tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
- CI: 4 workflows in .github/workflows/
- Pre-commit: Husky with npm test + git-secrets

## Key Conventions
- Conventional commits: feat:, fix:, refactor:, chore:, docs:
- Bilingual docs: [EN] / [ES] in JSDoc and markdown
- API design: named exports, no default exports, strict TypeScript
- All SDK modules in src/barrits/sdk/ have @module JSDoc
- CHANGELOG updated before every release/PR

## SDK Modules (src/barrits/sdk/)
- contracts — All types and interfaces
- discovery — Directory and file discovery
- inspect — Integration graph inspection
- manifest — Build manifest creation
- imports — Import action generation
- query — Graph filtering and querying
- validation — JSON schema validation
- summarization — State summary creation
- consume — Manifest/snapshot parsing + file I/O
- path — Path manipulation utilities
- guards — Type guards (BarritsFileKind, BarritsExportVisibility)
- cli-parser — Shared CLI argument parsing
- cli-format — CLI output formatting

## Adapters (adapters/)
- node/cli.ts — Node.js CLI (uses path.resolve)
- deno/cli.ts — Deno CLI (custom path resolution)

## Plugins (src/barrits/plugins/)
- vite, esbuild, rollup, webpack — Bundler plugins
- shared.ts — Shared plugin utilities (loadManifest, etc.)
